claims.claim: Cleanly used Electric bike for sale
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a black/silver motor scooter outdoors and it appears intact, but do not confirm cleanliness level, usage history, or overall condition beyond visible parts.
Witness report does not show the battery label/specs, battery compartment, or any readable markings confirming 72V/20Ah lead-acid.

risks.risk: Battery health/remaining capacity may be poor even if it is lead-acid; range and performance could be weak.
risks.proof: A clear photo/video of the battery label/specs AND a running test clip showing voltage under load (or a battery tester reading) plus ride/acceleration behavior.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a scooter with an unknown/possibly weak battery (worst case: needs battery replacement soon).

risks.risk: Whether it actually starts and runs well is unknown; the photo alone cannot confirm operation.
risks.proof: Short video clip of starting from cold, idling steadily, and a slow acceleration test with no cut-outs.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven running/needs inspection (worst case: non-running or intermittent).

risks.risk: Tyre and brake condition may be worn or unsafe; witness photos do not include tread depth, sidewall cracks, or brake responsiveness.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of front/rear tyres (tread + sidewalls) and a clip demonstrating braking (front and rear) with the scooter stopping smoothly.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming tyres/brakes may need service soon.

risks.risk: Electricals may have faults (indicators, horn, headlight/dip, tail/brake lights, charging).
risks.proof: Video showing full electrical check: headlight (high/low), indicators left/right, horn, tail light, brake light, and charging/voltage indicator if present.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming electrical issues are possible and may require parts/labour.

risks.risk: Hidden frame/body damage or rust may exist (alignment, dents, corrosion) not visible in the single outdoor photo.
risks.proof: Walk-around photos from multiple angles plus underside/frame close-ups showing welds, rust spots, and straightness/alignment.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unknown structural condition (worst case: minor damage affecting safety).

risks.risk: Ownership/documentation status is unknown; could be stolen or encumbered.
risks.proof: Photos of receipt/registration papers/serial number plate and any proof of ownership; clear serial/ID plate close-up.
risks.if_unproven: Price as no documents provided (worst case: legal/ownership risk).

proof_requests: Show a clear close-up photo of the battery label/specs (confirm 72V and 20Ah) and that it is lead-acid.
Provide a start-and-run video: start, idle, and gentle acceleration without cut-outs.
Show tyre close-ups (tread + sidewalls) for front and rear.
Show brake test video (front and rear) and close-ups of brake pads/shoes if accessible.
Provide an electricals test video: headlight (high/low), indicators, horn, tail light, brake light, and any charging/voltage indicator.
Provide ownership documents/receipt and a clear photo of the serial/registration plate.
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a motor scooter in photos, but key details that determine value in Rivers (battery specs/health, whether it runs well, and safety/electrical condition) are not verifiable from the report. Without those proof points, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
